W1.procedure: p=1..4 trainable C23 output-head coordinates, other coordinates fixed; R=0,2,6 IID reference suffix on all-zero/all-one labels, probability 1/2 each. L_i: central theta differences h=1e-5 along actual-to-surrogate segments. L_v: sum absolute relative-v derivatives h=1e-4 along second-moment segments, fixed kbar=1. H_G: sum absolute Hessian entries, central differences h=1e-3 and 5e-4, sampled radial segments and convex-hull Dirichlet points. No post-outcome padding. Analytic b uses forward sensitivities. Two-message equal-mean case is necessarily identical laws for distinct gradients.

W2.note: Same unscaled laws; fixed t=1000,m=0,beta. Varying v changes both kappa and the preconditioner. Raw gap can shrink faster than linearly; normalized gap isolates the kappa factor.

W3.fit_definition: Least squares median=c/(W+s), s=1..79 prior parameter updates; log-log slope free. Only positive finite medians enter the fit; their count n is reported, and unfittable series have null coefficients. All zero/infinite quantiles remain in per_step/raw. Reference warm-up law=P; shared IID prefixes across W. Nonstationarity and near-zero coordinates retained.

data.gap_design: E2 run_network and weighted_result unchanged. Exact histories when <=4096, otherwise independent 2000/source (240 quick). Same histories across W and branches. Warm-up is one declared common IID P prefix, conditional results; no averaging over warm-up prefixes.
